title: Founder’s Associate / Entrepreneur in Residence
summary: About us We’re a team of serial entrepreneurs who have built and scaled companies before, and we’re starting again. Our next venture tackles a problem every founder knows: protecting your brand is…
description:
About us
We’re a team of serial entrepreneurs who have built and scaled companies before, and we’re starting again. Our next venture tackles a problem every founder knows: protecting your brand is slow, expensive and confusing. We combine smart technology with real trademark expertise to make it simple.
We’re at the very beginning, and that’s exactly why we’re looking for you: someone who wants to build a company from day one, side by side with founders who’ve done it before.

What you’ll do
As our right hand, you’ll work on whatever matters most right now. In the first months, that includes:
Setting up the company: incorporation, structure, banking, legal and administrative set-up across countries

Go-to-market: shaping positioning and pricing, testing channels, and winning our first customers

Hiring: finding, approaching and onboarding our first team members, including trademark professionals across Europe

Partnerships: building relationships with partners, advisors and service providers

Operations: turning chaos into processes, and processes into something that scales

Anything else that moves the company forward, from investor materials to customer calls

What you bring
2–5 years of experience in a startup, scale-up, VC, consulting or a similar fast-paced environment

A strong bias for action: you get things done without waiting for perfect information

Structured thinking and the ability to switch between strategy and execution in the same hour

Excellent…

title: Regional Sales Director (m/w/d) – Vertriebsleitung Region Süd
summary: Du willst kein Gebiet verwalten. Du willst ein Team bauen, das auch ohne dich verkauft. Als Regional Sales Director führst du acht Leute im Außendienst zwischen Ulm, Augsburg und München, mit…
description:
Du willst kein Gebiet verwalten. Du willst ein Team bauen, das auch ohne dich verkauft. Als Regional Sales Director führst du acht Leute im Außendienst zwischen Ulm, Augsburg und München, mit KI-basierter Lead-Priorisierung, eigenem Forecast und Key-Account-Verhandlungen, die du selbst zum Abschluss bringst.

Standort: Großraum München – du arbeitest eigenständig in der Region Süd im Außendienst, mit rund 60 % Kundenterminen und 40 % Homeoffice, langfristig eher 50/50.

Über uns

CarOnSale ist die KI-gestützte Plattform für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa. Über 40.000 Käufer aus mehr als 20 Ländern handeln auf unserer Plattform – und 85 % des Inventars ist exklusiv bei uns. Wir verbinden Software, Pricing-Intelligenz, Logistik und Finanzierung in einer Schicht – als Betriebssystem für eine ganze Branche.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

Deine Aufgaben

Du baust das regionale Field-Sales-Team weiter auf und etablierst eine Leistungskultur, in der jede Person ihre Zahlen selbst verantwortet

Du entwickelst eine hybride Vertriebsstrategie, die digitale Tools mit persönlicher Kundennähe verbindet

Du implementierst klar strukturierte Vertriebsprozesse mit definierten Rollen

Du setzt die regionalen Wachstumsziele um und führst strategische Key-Account-Verhandlungen bis zum Abschluss

Du steuerst den Vertriebserfolg datengetrieben über KPIs, Forecasts und KI-basierte Lead-Priorisierung

Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale entlang der Customer Journey und hebst…

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack) - Merchant EMEA
summary: About Wolt  At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the…
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs…

title: Senior Risk & Fraud Prevention Analyst
summary: Senior Risk & Fraud Prevention Analyst  Berlin, Germany · Office-first · Permanent, full-time  Team description  Global Fraud Prevention protects SumUp's banking products, from issued cards to cash…
description:
Senior Risk & Fraud Prevention Analyst

Berlin, Germany · Office-first · Permanent, full-time

Team description

Global Fraud Prevention protects SumUp's banking products, from issued cards to cash in and cash out flows, keeping millions of merchants and consumers safe from financial crime. This role plays a key part in building stronger fraud observability and smarter decisioning for fast growing card issuing and banking volumes across the globe. Complex fraud data gets turned into practical controls here, working closely with fraud operations, data science, product, and engineering teams, as well as card payment networks, to stay ahead of evolving fraud patterns and comply with regulatory requirements in 38 active Sumup markets.

What you'll do

Build and maintain fraud observability dashboards covering issued card, cash in, and cash out flows across merchant and consumer banking products

Configure and refine decision engine rules to catch fraud early without adding unnecessary friction for genuine customers

Investigate fraud anomalies and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations for fraud operations and engineering teams

Partner with data science and engineering teams to improve risk logic and explore new data sources and automation opportunities

Translate PSD2, the upcoming PSD3, card scheme and other regulatory requirements into practical, workable controls

Share regular fraud performance updates with stakeholders across risk, compliance, and…

title: Senior Product Manager - SuperApp

description:
About the team:

The Engagement tribe sits at the heart of SumUp's merchant experience, responsible for the product surfaces that 4.3 million business owners interact with every day, from the information they see about their business to the actions they take to grow it. As our Senior Product Manager, you'll own the merchant facing SuperApp end to end, a rare individual contributor role spanning product strategy, UX quality, and squad delivery, on the single surface the wider product organisation depends on to build and ship effectively. If you're looking for a role where your product decisions have a direct impact on how millions of businesses run and scale every day, this is it.

What you'll do:

Own the end to end product experience of our SuperApp across iOS, Android and web dashboard, raising the bar on UX quality, information architecture, and navigation for the surfaces merchants rely on most

Spot and execute activation, upsell, cross sell, and retention opportunities that measurably grow engagement and long term value for merchants

Shape the product strategy that makes the SuperApp an essential, everyday tool for small business owners running their business globally

Act as the main point of contact for stakeholders across the business who depend on the SuperApp to reach merchants, partnering closely with design and data on priorities

Build strong working relationships across engineering, design, and commercial teams, turning direct merchant insight into a clear,…

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Run & Grow
summary: About the Run & Grow:  Run & Grow is where SumUp builds the platforms and capabilities that help merchants discover, join, use, and continue growing with our products. The tribe brings together…
description:
About the Run & Grow:

Run & Grow is where SumUp builds the platforms and capabilities that help merchants discover, join, use, and continue growing with our products. The tribe brings together engineering, product, design, and revenue operations teams around two connected goals: helping SumUp serve and retain merchants, and accelerating acquisition, activation, and engagement.

Our work sits at the heart of SumUp’s growth engine. We turn complex challenges across merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, commercial systems, operations, risk, and compliance into reliable products and services that other teams can build on. The systems we create help SumUp move faster, make better decisions, and deliver a simpler experience to millions of small businesses.

Joining Run & Grow means working on high-impact engineering problems with a broad view of the business. You’ll collaborate across disciplines and teams, shape the foundations behind important merchant journeys, and help create a more connected, scalable way for SumUp to run and grow.

What you’ll do:

Design, build, and operate production-grade backend services, APIs, and integrations, primarily using Go.

Build event-driven workflows and distributed systems using technologies such as Kafka and asynchronous processing.

Define clear service boundaries, data models, schemas, and API contracts that other teams can use confidently.

Build capabilities supporting merchant acquisition, identity, marketing…

description:
About the team

Within the Global Operations organisation, our mission is to build the best customer experience in the fintech industry by delivering an effortless customer experience to all our merchants. We are seeking a skilled and passionate Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our talented AI team and lead the development of AI models and algorithms that will drive our customer support service to new heights.

As an AI / Machine Learning Engineer at SumUp, you will be responsible for building and optimising state-of-the-art AI models and algorithms. Your expertise with machine learning, deep learning, and LLMs will be crucial in driving the success of our AI-driven initiatives. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including backend engineers, data scientists and product managers, to translate business requirements into innovative AI solutions. Your contributions will shape the future of our support products and help us stay at the forefront of technological advancements in the field of AI.

What you’ll do

Design, develop and deploy our AI solutions and systems in production environments, ensuring reliability, high performance and scalability.

Collaborate and communicate closely with data scientists, product managers, developers and other business stakeholders to bring state-of-the-art AI solutions to Customer Support, enhancing customer experience and improving operational efficiency.

title: Marketing Einkauf Werkstudent (m/w/d)
summary: Kurz und knapp  Als Online-Supermarkt ist das Herzstück unseres Businesses natürlich die Picnic App. Das Category Management Team sorgt dafür, dass unsere digitalen Regale perfekt mit den besten…
description:
Kurz und knapp

Als Online-Supermarkt ist das Herzstück unseres Businesses natürlich die Picnic App. Das Category Management Team sorgt dafür, dass unsere digitalen Regale perfekt mit den besten lokalen und internationalen Produkten ausgestattet sind – und das immer frisch und zu den besten Preisen.

Als WerkstudentIn (m/w/d) bist du das operative Rückgrat dieses Teams und bekommst tiefe Einblicke in den E-Commerce und den FMCG-Bereich (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods). Du tauchst tief in Daten ein, unterstützt bei der Sortimentsgestaltung und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Produkte in der App optimal präsentiert werden. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Category Managern sowie cross-funktionalen Teams (wie Supply Chain und Marketing) zusammen, pflegst wichtige Stammdaten und hilfst dabei, dass unsere App für die KundInnen immer perfekt gepflegt ist. Mit deinem analytischen Denken und smarten Automatisierungstools machst du unsere Prozesse zudem jeden Tag ein Stückchen besser.

Das erwartet dich

Unterstützung im Tagesgeschäft: Du hilfst unseren Category Managern bei operativen und administrativen Aufgaben im E-Commerce-Alltag – von der Ein- und Auslistung von Produkten bis hin zur Überprüfung von Datenblättern.

App & Content Pflege: Du bist mitverantwortlich für den In-App Content deiner Produktkategorien. Du sorgst dafür, dass Artikelbeschreibungen, Bilder und Promotions immer up-to-date sind und unseren KundInnen ein Lächeln ins Gesicht zaubern.

Daten & Analysen: Du wertest…

description:
A career driven by you. At LeasingMarkt.de, we bring customers and dealers together to make car leasing more accessible, transparent, and efficient. With over 1,000 partner dealerships and nearly 2 million users across the DACH region and the Netherlands, we’ve become Germany’s #1 leasing platform. To keep growing and driving innovation in the mobility space, we’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our high-performance team at our Düsseldorf office. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing and developing robust, scalable applications that power one of the largest automotive leasing marketplaces in Europe. You’ll collaborate with a cross-functional team to build and evolve solutions that are architecturally sound, easy to maintain, and built for long-term impact. You’ll help shape technical direction while raising the bar for software quality and stability across the platform. 

What you’ll do:

Join one of our builders’ teams to build great products loved by our customers. 

Apply an AI-first mindset to every phase of you-build-it-you-run-it: from design and coding to testing, deployment and operations.

Work hands-on in real product codebases (for example TypeScript/Node/Next.js or Java/Spring), using GenAI tools to accelerate development, improve quality and simplify existing systems.

description:
A career driven by you. At LeasingMarkt.de, we bring customers and dealers together to make car leasing more accessible, transparent, and efficient.  

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead product direction for LeasingMarkt’s Attraction & Loyalty team. You’ll help us build stronger relationships with consumers, from their first interaction through returning visits and qualified enquiries.This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role. You’ll identify the right problems, set clear priorities and work with your team to deliver measurable improvements. Your focus will be on making LeasingMarkt a more useful part of people’s car-shopping journey: helping them discover relevant offers, giving them reasons to return and creating better-qualified demand for our dealer partners. 

What you’ll do 

Own the product direction and roadmap for Attraction & Loyalty, translating customer needs and business priorities into a focused set of opportunities.

Improve activation and ongoing engagement through experiences such as onboarding, accounts, saved offers, personalised recommendations and useful reasons to return.

Build connected journeys across web, app and lifecycle touchpoints, working closely with CRM, Marketing and the app team. Make communication and product experiences reinforce each other.

Use customer research, behavioural data and commercial context to understand what prevents people from taking the next meaningful step.

summary: About the opportunity  As an Enterprise Account Executive - DACH (f/m/d), you’ll drive Contentful’s growth by leading the end-to-end sales process with our top-tier clients. You’ll be instrumental in…
description:
About the opportunity

As an Enterprise Account Executive - DACH (f/m/d), you’ll drive Contentful’s growth by leading the end-to-end sales process with our top-tier clients. You’ll be instrumental in driving adoption and engagement, finding new revenue opportunities, and creating customer enablement initiatives within a few named accounts.  You’ll work closely with our partnership and customer success team to lead a consultative sales process by speaking to professional developers and business leaders in the DACH markets. 

What to expect?

Self-generation of the pipeline through outbound motions in conjunction with marketing and BDR teams to help create new opportunities in regional accounts

Drive expansion opportunities with existing clients in the DACH (Germany, Austria & Switzerland) territory

Grow existing accounts by leveraging relationships and following our comprehensive “land and expand” sales model

Meet quarterly and annual sales goals by developing an account strategy and pipeline, managing internal and client processes, maintaining sales reports, developing market and competitor knowledge, delivering presentations to customers, and creating sales proposals

Manage RFI/RFQ requests with Contentful internal and customer teams

Refine and evolve our "land-and-expand" model in collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams

title: (Senior) Manager Group Accounting (m/f/d)
summary: A career driven by you. Join AutoScout24 Group and experience life in the fast lane. We’re not just leading the market; we’re creating it. We’re constantly innovating, evolving, and transforming…
description:
A career driven by you.
Join AutoScout24 Group and experience life in the fast lane. We’re not just leading the market; we’re creating it. We’re constantly innovating, evolving, and transforming things for our customers. We’re driven, ambitious, and determined to do our best work together. For a career that doesn’t stand still, where you can put your ideas in the driving seat and change the way the world moves, join our international community.

Why this role is unique

Central role at the core of Group Finance and consolidation

Coordination of the group consolidation process in a multi-entity environment

Exposure to complex technical accounting topics

High visibility across Finance and close collaboration with Group Reporting

Strong development path into senior roles within Group Accounting

What you’ll do

Coordinate the group consolidation process (in OneStream) across all entities

Perform IFRS adjustments and technical accounting calculations

Validate and reconcile financial data from all legal entities

Ensure consistency and integrity of group financial data

Deliver accurate and reliable data as basis for Group Financial Reporting

What you’ll bring

Hands-on experience in group accounting or consolidation

Root is Europe’s #1 primary data collection platform for F&B companies. We help our customers to measure and reduce farm-level emissions.
~31% of global GHG emissions originate from food-related activities. For the first time in history, climate performance has become an overall business performance indicator. About Kernel
Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role

description:
About Fractile
Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. 

About the Hardware organisation at Fractile
Processor Architecture sits within Fractile’s hardware organisation, which owns everything from compute engine definition and ISA design through memory hierarchies, on-chip interconnects, and the path from early architectural exploration through to tapeout and post-silicon validation. Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.
Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team.
Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. description:
About The Opportunity
We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows.
We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches.
Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity

What You’ll Deliver 
Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents.

Asset Creation: Build realistic task environments using datasets and files in your native language. Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling.

Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language

 Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary).

Calibration & Execution: Analyze execution logs and calibrate task difficulty (Easy to Very Hard) using standard Terminal-Bench run configurations against various model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus).

About Us
AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and…

We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.

Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

Building AI-native products is a different problem than building deterministic software: the same input won't always produce the same output. Good product engineering here means designing experiences that stay useful, trustworthy, and easy to understand even when the AI underneath doesn't behave the same way twice — and knowing when that's a product design problem, not just a model problem.
We're looking for a Software Engineer with 2-7 years of experience who thinks like a product owner, not just an implementer. You're comfortable being handed a vague, half-formed problem and figuring out what's actually worth building. You default to empathy for the researcher or participant on the other end of the screen, and you'd rather ship something real and learn from it than wait for a perfect spec. You're fluent enough with modern LLM-based systems to build good product experiences on top of them, even if tuning the model itself isn't your job.

description:
Account Executive, DACH, Commercial (Existing Business)

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Commercial Grower team works with the most ambitious and fastest growing companies in the Commercial segment. Our Commercial segment includes businesses typically processing $20M–$50M in annual payment volume. Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and growth opportunities for these businesses. The Commercial Grower team supports our users to increase their domestic presence whilst expanding into new territories and unlocking new revenue streams. This is a role that can be based out of our Dublin or Berlin office or Germany remote. 

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive (Existing Business), you will deepen and expand partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing companies in EMEA by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their…

What you’ll do

Stripe is growing its Enterprise sales team in Mexico City. As an Account Executive, you will own a blended, full-lifecycle sales motion: building new strategic relationships while expanding Stripe’s impact within existing enterprise accounts.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe builds financial infrastructure for businesses—from ambitious startups to global enterprises. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we’re building the tools that help businesses participate in and grow the global economy.

About the team

Stripe’s Crypto team is building financial infrastructure for a world where money moves as easily as information. Across Stripe, Bridge, and Privy, we help businesses build products powered by stablecoins, wallets, and programmable money movement.

Open Issuance is central to that opportunity. Built by Bridge, a Stripe company, it enables businesses to launch and manage their own stablecoins. Alongside it, Open Standard—the independent organization behind Open USD (OUSD)—is building a shared stablecoin network with broad distribution and economics designed to benefit the businesses driving adoption. 

We’re hiring one of the founding sellers of our Open Issuance go-to-market team. You’ll partner closely with Open Standard and teams across Stripe, Bridge, and Privy on a major strategic bet: challenging the stablecoin duopoly and giving businesses more choice, control, and participation in the economics of digital dollars.

This is an opportunity to help build a market—not simply sell into an established one.

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge —you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

About the team

Fraud Strategy is responsible for building scaled fraud mitigation systems that prevent fraud and protect the financial ecosystem, while minimizing disruption to good users. The fraud team’s mission is to protect Stripe, our users, and the broader financial ecosystem from actors who abuse Stripe accounts for financial gain.

What you’ll do

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches.

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Who we are 

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

description:
Who we are
About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About the Role

As an early member of the Bridge engineering team, you'll have the autonomy to work on projects that are truly global in scale and aim to give customers access to products they've never had access to. Many of the use cases that we work on today didn't exist several months ago, and that's because our team is dedicated to constant improvement for our partners and end users. Our engineers have outsized ownership…

title: Electronics Engineer
summary: As an Electronics Engineer, you will be a member of our interdisciplinary hardware engineering team, contributing to the design and development of electronics for our next-generation drone platforms.…
description:
As an Electronics Engineer, you will be a member of our interdisciplinary hardware engineering team, contributing to the design and development of electronics for our next-generation drone platforms. You’ll work on electronic modules such as flight controllers, sensors, and vision systems, supporting PCB development from concept through production.

As part of a cross-functional team, you will contribute to advanced systems such as interceptor and reconnaissance drones with integrated visual navigation, as well as quadcopters for defense applications.

Responsibilities and Duties

The Community You Will Join

Airbnb’s Data Infrastructure organization builds the platforms that power data across the company. Within it, the Data Movement & Transformation (DMT) pillar builds the platform that moves data between Airbnb’s storage engines and transforms it along the way.

Today, data moves through many bespoke, one-off pipelines that are built and maintained differently by each team. We’re replacing them with one unified, declarative platform. You define data once, and it is replicated everywhere it needs to go. This work underpins Airbnb’s Data as a Service initiative.

You’ll join the team that owns three connected layers of that platform:

Control plane: the layer that turns declarative data definitions into running pipelines, including provisioning, runtime selection, and lifecycle management.

Schema: how schemas are defined, tracked, and evolved safely across every system and engine.

Realtime Data Infrastructure (RTDI): Kafka and the streaming transport layer that real-time data flows through at scale.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll set technical direction across these layers and stay…

Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As a Compliance Engineer at Figma, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and testing security controls across multiple compliance frameworks, including FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST. You will collaborate closely with security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams to translate regulatory requirements into effective technical controls, evaluate control effectiveness, and identify opportunities to improve security and compliance processes. You will also help advance Figma’s compliance engineering capabilities by leveraging automation, machine-readable control definitions (JSON), APIs, and AI-assisted development tools to streamline control testing, evidence collection, and continuous monitoring. This role combines deep security compliance expertise with technical problem-solving to build scalable, repeatable, and effective compliance practices.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.
